mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained low-cost capital for corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% over three consecutive months indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC over 2-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness that triggers revenue expectation revisions downward, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declining, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105.0 with monthly growth below 0.5% signals supply chain bottlenecks that increase input costs and compress profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price inflation above 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations that prompt central bank policy tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate capital expenditure, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 months, or Rank IC over 2-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 4.0% and nonfarm payrolls declining below 50,000 indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 3.0% combined with FEDFUNDS above 2.0% defines a monetary tightening cycle that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.
